282.text: Which of the following is not a bioassay for cytokinins?
282.sol: Cytokinins have the ability to retard the degradation of chlorophyll in excised leaves. Hence, chlorophyll preservation test is a bioassay for cytokinin. 127073.sol: DDT or dichloro-diphenyl trichloroethane was the first important synthetic pesticide (organo chlorine) discovered in 1939 by a Swiss chemist Paul Muller. 305653.text: An iron railway track is installed in winter at an average temperature of 18^ C . The track is made up of 12.0 m sections placed consecutively. What gap must be provided between two adjacent sections to prevent compression in summer, when the peak temperature reaches 48^ C ? The coefficient of linear expansion for iron is 11 10⁻⁶^ C ⁻¹ .
305653.sol: The gap to be provided between two adjacent sections must be equal to the expansion of one section to prevent compression. The initial length of the track section is L = 12.0 m . The change in temperature is T = 48^ C - 18^ C = 30^ C . The coefficient of linear expansion is = 11 10⁻⁶^ C ⁻¹ . The increase in length of one section is given by: L = L T Substituting the given values: L = 12.0 11 10⁻⁶ 30 L = 3960 10⁻⁶ m L = 3.96 10⁻³ m Converting to centimeters: L = 0.396 cm Thus, a gap of 0.396 cm must be provided.
